description: Land Acquisition - Thallalla, Devenuwara D/S Division, Matara District
categorisation: This gazette content is primarily focused on land acquisition matters under the Land Acquisition Act. It contains a formal declaration by the Minister for the acquisition of specific land parcels for public purpose, including detailed descriptions of the land boundaries, extents, and locations. The content deals exclusively with land and property-related administrative matters, fitting the definition of Type 4 (Land Gazettes) for land registrations, acquisitions, and property descriptions.
